title: MoU signed between IPC and UP Pharmacy Council (UPPC) to promote rational use of medicines through NFI
bodyHtml: MoU signed between Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC) and UP Pharmacy Council (UPPC) to promote rational use of medicines through NFI. The UPPC will make mandatory for the registered pharmacists in the state to subscribe NFI. The UPPC is the first State Pharmacy Council in the country to collaborate with IPC for the larger interest of the patients safety.
